newsitem.title: KENYA: Foreign tourist shot dead in northern Kenya.
newsitem.headline: Foreign tourist shot dead in northern Kenya.

text.p: Cattle rustlers shot dead a foreign tourist in northern Kenya after mistaking a tourism vehicle for security forces trying to intercept them, tour operators said on Wednesday.

The Kenya Association of Tour Operators (KATO) said the tourist travelling with a group of other foreign visitors was killed on Monday by a bullet fired through the windscreen of a four-wheel-drive Toyota Landcruiser in northern Kenya.
A KATO statement gave no details about the person killed but said security forces were pursuing the cattle rustlers and by Tuesday had killed five bandits and recovered some livestock.
Police in Nairobi were unavailable to comment on the attack.
The body of the tourist and the survivors were evacuated by air to the Kenyan capital on Tuesday, the KATO statement said.
It added it was believed the same gang attacked two other tourist vehicles on Tuesday but there were no other casualties.
"It is believed the bandits attacked the tourist vehicles mistaking them for security forces. There was no attempt at robbery," said KATO, adding tour operators were advised to use a different route.
